concerns.text: T028 (bootstrap) lacks an explicit dependency on T007 (τ_int calculation). FR-006 mandates thinning by ≥ 2τ_int BEFORE bootstrapping. Without a hard dependency, the task allows bootstrapping on correlated data, violating the statistical validity of the 95% CI (SC-004).

T027 (GP smoothing) is marked incomplete. FR-005 and US-3 Acceptance Scenario 1 require a specific GP kernel (squared-exponential) and derivative thresholds (< -0.01) for T* identification. Leaving this task incomplete means the core detection mechanism is unimplemented, violating FR-005.

T030 (cross-validation) depends on T007 (susceptibility χ). T007 is marked incomplete/rejected in the failure context. Without χ, FR-008 (Independent Physical Verification) and Constitution Principle VII cannot be satisfied, breaking the validation chain for the ML-derived T*.

T029 (FSS logic) and T029b (reporting ν) are incomplete. FR-010 and SC-001 require extrapolation to L→∞ and reporting of the exponent ν. The absence of these tasks means the thermodynamic limit extrapolation is missing, violating the core success criteria.

T031 (flat variance fallback) is incomplete. FR-005 explicitly requires reporting 'No significant transition detected' with reconstruction error metrics if the variance curve is flat. The missing task leaves the system without defined behavior for this edge case, violating FR-005.

T008 (env config/seeds) is rejected, and T037 (seed verification) is deferred to Phase 6. Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) and FR-001 require pinned seeds in `code/` as a foundational prerequisite. Deferring seed implementation to a final verification step violates the 'Reproducibility' gate.

T006b (dataset schema) and T006c (latent schema) are rejected. Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene) requires checksums and schema validation for all data. Without these schemas, the checksumming and validation workflow for processed data and latent outputs is undefined, violating Principle III.

T023 (memory enforcement for analysis) is rejected. SC-003 requires measuring the *entire* pipeline (including analysis and bootstrap) against the 6h/7GB limits. T022 only covers training. Without T023, the analysis phase could exceed memory/time limits, violating SC-003.
